name: Jurassic World Camp Cretaceous
description: Six teens attending an adventure camp on the opposite side of Isla Nublar must band together to survive when dinosaurs wreak havoc on the island.

videos.title: Camp Cretaceous
videos.overview: After waiting his whole life to see dinosaurs, lucky Darius wins the chance to join five other campers on Isla Nublar for a once-in-a-lifetime adventure.

videos.title: Secrets
videos.overview: With the rest of the crew off visiting a genetics lab, Kenji sneaks Darius into the park's top-secret underbelly — and straight into danger.

videos.title: The Cattle Drive
videos.overview: The campers hop into their Gyrospheres to help move a dinosaur herd toward fresh grazing lands. But an incoming storm stirs up unexpected trouble.

videos.title: Things Fall Apart
videos.overview: Darius remembers the promise he made to his dad. Elsewhere on the island, the campers find themselves face-to-face with a newly freed threat.

videos.title: Happy Birthday, Eddie!
videos.overview: After a close encounter with the Indominus, the gang seeks shelter in the genetics lab, where a strange scientist reveals the truth about Dr. Wu.

videos.title: Welcome to Jurassic World
videos.overview: Sammy's secret shocks everyone — but there's no time for anger when an accident unleashes a flock of Pteranodons and forces the crew below ground.

videos.title: Last Day of Camp
videos.overview: The campers leave the Mosasaurus lagoon and fight their way onto the monorail … where Ben gets a chance to face his fears.

videos.title: End of the Line
videos.overview: It's a race against time as the campers make their way to the main dock to catch the last ferry leaving the island. But what if they're too late?

videos.title: A Beacon of Hope
videos.overview: Still stranded on the island — and still reeling from the apparent loss of Ben — the campers make a last-ditch attempt at rescue by sending out an SOS.

videos.title: The Art of Chill
videos.overview: Darius and Sammy face a moral dilemma while searching the park for supplies. The campers start building a new treehouse. Brooklynn sees something odd.

videos.title: The Watering Hole
videos.overview: Brooklynn, Sammy and Yasmina team up to investigate strange noises in the park. Elsewhere, Darius and Kenji go exploring and witness a majestic sight.

videos.title: Salvation
videos.overview: A bonfire in the distance signals that the campers have company: a pair of posh eco-tourists and their disgruntled security guy. But can they be trusted?

videos.title: Brave
videos.overview: The campers reunite with a long-lost friend, who shares an inspiring story — then reveals that Mitch, Tiff and Hap aren't who they seem.

videos.title: Misguided
videos.overview: Darius must make a difficult choice to save Sammy and Yasmina. Meanwhile, the remaining campers are trying to decide if Hap is a friend... or a foe.

videos.title: Step One
videos.overview: Brooklynn, Ben, Kenji and Yasmina work to uncover a secret and restore power to the park as Darius leads Mitch and Tiff straight into a T. rex trap.

videos.title: Chaos Theory
videos.overview: A guilty Darius is determined to protect the island's innocent dinos — even if he has to do it all alone. But with luck, maybe he won't have to...

videos.title: View from the Top
videos.overview: The campers catch a lift to Lookout Point in search of materials to make a sail, then must quickly find a way back down. Ben worries about leaving Bumpy.

videos.title: Safe Harbor
videos.overview: After finding Mitch and Tiff's abandoned yacht, the happy campers celebrate. But the party's over when something big goes bump in the night.

videos.title: Casa De Kenji
videos.overview: Kenji takes the campers to his father's penthouse to gather supplies — but they've soon got company. Sammy reflects on what life must be like back home.

videos.title: Clever Girl
videos.overview: A thrilling chase brings Darius, Kenji and Yaz to the old Jurassic Park Visitors Center. Elsewhere on the island, Brooklynn and Sammy find a secret lab.

videos.title: Eye of the Storm
videos.overview: Sammy and Brooklynn rush to warn the others about a sinister new threat while Darius, unaware of the danger, searches for his dad's favorite dinosaur.

videos.title: The Long Run
videos.overview: As a poisoned camper fights to survive, it's up to Yaz — the fastest among them — to fetch the antidote before it's too late.

videos.title: A Shock to the System
videos.overview: It's crunch time for the campers to get to the boat and make their escape... until Ben disappears, deciding he'd rather stay. Can Darius change his mind?

videos.title: Escape from Isla Nublar
videos.overview: With multiple threats running rampant on the island, dinosaur lover Darius must put his feelings aside and make a difficult decision.

videos.title: Whatever It Takes
videos.overview: The group is forced to switch gears when a familiar face returns to Isla Nublar. Now, getting off the island is no longer the most important thing.

videos.title: Stay on Mission
videos.overview: With Brooklynn being held prisoner, the remaining campers hatch a plan to rescue her — and it won't be easy.

videos.title: Beneath the Surface
videos.overview: Out at sea, the campers see sunny skies... then discover a stowaway on board. A surprise attack from the deep leaves them stranded on unfamiliar shores.

videos.title: At Least...
videos.overview: The weary crew dodges danger in the desert while trying to figure out where they are. But they unearth more questions than answers.

videos.title: Turning Dr. Turner
videos.overview: A strange tunnel takes the teens to a lush forest, where they meet a mysterious scientist studying dino behavior. The question is: Can they trust her?

videos.title: Rude Awakening
videos.overview: With Dr. Turner's help, the campers hatch a plan to get off the island that finds them crossing a snowy arctic biome — and making a selfless rescue.

videos.title: The Long Game
videos.overview: After learning the truth about Mae's boss, Sammy's ready to go rogue to take him down... just as Mae gets ready to confront him. Cue the killer robots!

videos.title: Mission Critical
videos.overview: With Mae in serious condition and Kash's end game clear, the campers vow to save the dinosaurs and stop Mantah Corp. But evil BRADs are everywhere.

videos.title: Staying Alive
videos.overview: Darius has to think fast to distract Kash and protect the others, so he pretends to hate dinos as much as Kash does — while learning everything he can.

videos.title: Technical Difficulties
videos.overview: Brooklynn must devise a hack to help Darius, who's being tailed by an upgraded BRAD-X. Meanwhile, Kash prepares to woo a group of dangerous investors.

videos.title: Dino-Sitting
videos.overview: Darius keeps Kash busy with competitive video gaming while the others break into the nursery. Yaz asks Brooklynn how she feels about Kenji.

videos.title: Taking Control
videos.overview: Ben's refusal to bond with a new friend leads to regret — and a realization that it's time to take Kash down. Kenji and Brooklynn face their feelings.

videos.title: Who's the Boss?
videos.overview: Just when it feels like things are getting back to normal, Kash's boss arrives on Mantah Corp. island and begins moving forward with a devastating plan.

videos.title: Reunited
videos.overview: Kenji's thrilled to see his father - and eager to prove himself. Elsewhere, Sammy and Brooklynn team up to find out what happened to Sammy's family.

videos.title: The Final Test
videos.overview: A cryptic clue prompts Brooklynn, Darius and Ben to dig into Mr. Kon's motives. Kenji plans a date with Brooklynn while helping his dad prep for a party.

videos.title: Battle Lines
videos.overview: Kenji asks his friends to back off and stay out of his father's business. But to save the island's dinos, they're willing to risk breaking his trust.

videos.title: Evasive Action
videos.overview: A stunning betrayal lands the friends in lockdown, where they unpack their feelings and plot their escape. Kenji follows his father to Isla Nublar.

videos.title: Shaky Ground
videos.overview: Something unsettling is sending the dinos into a frenzy. Darius and Brooklynn pour their energies into problem-solving. Kenji chooses sides.

videos.title: Out of the Pack
videos.overview: Kenji accepts an important assignment - and drives straight into danger. Back on Mantah Corp. Island, the others race to ruin Mr, Kon's plans.

videos.title: The Leap
videos.overview: The Kids come up with a plan to protect the dinosaurs. Left on her own, Sammy will have to rely on her own strength. Yaz opens up to Ben.

videos.title: Clean Break
videos.overview: An Increasingly suspicious Kenji starts looking into his father's activities. Mae works to break free from Kon's control and follow her heart.

videos.title: The Core
videos.overview: Yaz is ready to tell Sammy the truth - but the island has other plans. A conflicted Darius worries that he's lost his way.

videos.title: Arrival
videos.overview: The friends must think fast to outwit Mr. Kon and his cronies. Ben sets out to rescue an old friend - and gets help from a surprising source.

videos.title: The Last Stand
videos.overview: A high-stakes battle begins for control of Mantah Corp. Island. Kenji's ready to rejoin his friends, but Darius isn't sure he can forgive him.

videos.title: The Nublar Six
videos.overview: With the future of the Island at steak, the friends band together - and fight harder than ever before - to protect what's really important.
